text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I still have some free time before my gym 
reservation...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Hm... You there, draw near. What are you 
flustered about? Yes, you.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I shall permit you to converse with me for 
a brief moment. —Now, entertain me.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I won't take "I can't" for an answer. Now, 
then...
